correctness.rationale: The stationary density is a positive trace-class exponential-age mixture of pure quantum-walk states. Double-age trace reduces exactly to r Laplace{J0(2kappa t)^(2d)}(r). The long-time Bessel expansion is t^-d times a_d plus a nonzero-frequency trigonometric polynomial with bounded primitive and O(t^-d-1), where a_d=binom(2d,d)/[4^d(pi kappa)^d]. Taylor subtraction through j=d-2 followed by 1<t<1/r yields the first r^d log(kappa/r) coefficient (-1)^(d-1)a_d/(d-1)!, with O(r^d) nonlog remainder. d=1 elliptic transform and strong-reset series independently reconcile normalization; numerical quadratures match exactly to 1e-9. No uniform-in-d assertion.
residual_risks: Remainder depends on each fixed d,kappa; no finite-size/r joint limiting result; ordinary trajectory purity is 1, ensemble purity is analyzed.
